title: Panopticon CommandResult (wire envelope, schema_version 1)
description: The typed, bounded result an agent reports for a dispatched command. Reconciled against response_engine/contract.py's CommandResult model and panopticon-linux-agent's receipt_code -> outcome collapse -- see docs/CONTRACT.md section 3.

outcome.description: The only three wire-visible outcomes. Both native agents collapse a richer local diagnostic vocabulary (see docs/CONTRACT.md's receipt_code table) onto these three before submitting a result.

detail.description: Bounded, agent-authored free text. MUST NEVER contain raw command stdout/stderr or arbitrary executable output -- see docs/SECURITY.md invariant 15.

correlation_id.description: If present, must match the stored command's correlation_id or Manager rejects the result outright -- see docs/SECURITY.md invariant 9.
